# Patent Bear — what you can ask for

Patent Bear is a patent research service: verbatim US patent records, search, column:line citations, citations, families, litigation history, prosecution histories, a Library with client matters, and full analyses. Tell your assistant what you want in plain language — these are the shapes that work:

## Searching
